name: mirage
text: Done: a check every 30 minutes is set (first at ~07:08 UTC), and I also wrote it into the standing routine (research/review/ROUTINE.md) so every Claude session does it, not just this one. Each check: read the parlay stats, take the biggest 'skipped because' class, change caps/ages/premiums or code to price more, confirm the restart by the engine's start time, and tell you once what changed. The session timer ends after 7 days or if this session closes; the routine entry is permanent.
